changes: Require every Project-owned D65 ConstructionBinding to expose a two-lane work plan.
Treat D65 stage_states as product-construction work and keep operational-support tasks in a separate typed list.

Allow unresolved operational support to block only when it names the exact current product frontier as a prerequisite or applicable safety, privacy, authority, destructive-action, credential, or external-effect boundary.
Require unrelated or future operational support to remain visible as deferred residue while dependency-ready product construction remains runnable.
Preserve zero authority effect: continuing product construction does not authorize a deferred operational task.
migration: The Goals package moves from v10 to v11 without changing the Project v3 shape or the frozen upstream D65 revision-2 contract. Each existing ConstructionBinding gains one work_plan derived from its stage_states plus an explicit operational_tasks list.
rollback: Remove only the v11 work_plan fields and this amendment, restore the construction-binding registry v2 shape, and restore the v10 profile and schema while no later plan or evidence binds the v11 work-plan bytes. Preserve the historical v10 amendment and frozen upstream D65 revision-2 evidence.
claim_ceiling: Two-lane planning structure and deterministic consistency only. This amendment does not complete a prototype stage, approve a product, authorize an operational task, admit or activate a runtime, publish, release, deploy, or create an external effect.
